mcp_tools.name: negotiation_preparation_pack
mcp_tools.title: Negotiation preparation pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a negotiation preparation record (BATNA, reservation price and ZOPA, interests and value creation, improvisation and adaptation, openings/moments/closing and tactics, debrief and anti-pattern red lines) and returns a deterministic NEGOTIATION_PREPARATION_SOUND / NEGOTIATION_PREPARATION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-issue interest and trade-potential coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared preparation record; it negotiates nothing and sets no figures.

inputSchema.description: The negotiation preparation pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All 44 checks pass. computed_spot_checks: issues_count=1, own_interest_coverage=1.000000, counterpart_interest_coverage=1.000000, trade_potential_assessed_coverage=1.000000
